title: Excel Solutions
summary: A bilingual Excel tutorials and automation blog for accountants.
description: Excel Solutions publishes step-by-step tutorials on formulas, automation, and data analysis for accountants and professionals, including CFDI and SAT workflows written specifically for Mexican accountants. Content spans automation, security, data analysis, data entry, visualization, and Python. Same throughline as this portfolio's Excel Lab section: real engineering practice applied to spreadsheet problems accountants normally solve by hand.

title: Pura Vida Vallarta Tours
summary: A bilingual tour-curation site for Puerto Vallarta and Bahia de Banderas.
description: Pura Vida Vallarta Tours curates the best tours and experiences around Bahia de Banderas so visitors do not have to guess which operator is worth booking. Bilingual (Spanish/English), video previews for each tour, and WhatsApp-based booking instead of a traditional checkout flow, matching how the target audience actually books travel in the region.
